jp: ったく、ステイエンのやつ
本当に殺す気で殴りやがって
死んだらどうするんだよ？
en: Sheesh, Stayen... She hit me like she actually meant to kill me. What if I'd died?

jp: すごいパンチだったもんね
en: It was an amazing punch, though.

jp: しかもステイエンのやつ
平手じゃなくて拳だぜ？
en: And get this, she didn't slap me. She used her FIST.

jp: 前歯の二、三本いってたぜ・・・
en: A little worse and I'd have lost two or three front teeth...

jp: 無事でよかったね、エクサル
en: I'm glad you're okay, Exal.
Yeah.

jp: しかし、女ってのは・・・
人数集まるとうるさいよな～
en: Still, women... Get enough of them together and they get loud, huh?
Whoa!?

jp: 人のことじろじろ見て・・・
en: What? Why are you staring at me like that...
What's your problem!

jp: すっごいと思ってたけれど
何を食べたらそんなに
en: I knew you were big, but what do you EAT to grow like that!?

jp: あんただってアタシと比べて
へこむほど貧弱じゃないじゃない
en: Compared to me, you're not so flat you need to feel bad about it.

jp: ステイエンさんはいい方です
en: That's right. Stayen-san is one of the lucky ones. Unlike me...
Me, I'm...

jp: リリスもぺったんなのー！
en: Lilis is flat too!

jp: にぎやかなのはいいけれど
en: Lively is all well and good, but we can hear every word...
Hm? What's wrong, Kilota?
Eh... M-me?

jp: 入る前からのぼせてるのか？
en: What, are you overheating before you've even gotten in?

jp: そんなんじゃ・・・・
en: N-no! It's not like that....

jp: ・・おい、あいつはどうした？
en: ...Hey, what happened to him?
Huh? Him?
Johannes. Where is he?

jp: 下手に単独行動をしていると
あらぬ疑いをかけられるぞ？
en: Wander off alone like that and people will start suspecting things.

jp: 蒸気で仮面が気持ち悪いから、
ちょっと場所を変えるって・・・
en: Johannes said the steam makes his mask feel gross, so he's moving somewhere else...

jp: 確かにこの温泉の蒸気の中じゃ
en: Yeah, in all this steam a mask would get pretty stuffy...
Right?
Hm? Hey, wait a minute...
What is it?

jp: 気持ち悪いから移動したって
en: If the steam makes his mask gross so he moved, that means....
Means what?

jp: 今ごろどこかで仮面を外して
en: Johannes-san's probably off somewhere right now with his mask OFF!?
Huh?

jp: これはヨハネさんの素顔を拝む
en: Cain! This is our chance to see Johannes-san's real face!!
Johannes's real face...

jp: このチャンスを逃す手はない！
en: We can't pass up this chance! Let's go!!

jp: ヨハネの仮面に対するガードは
異常なまでにかたいから・・・
en: Hmm, but Johannes guards that mask like crazy...

jp: このチャンスを生かすべきだ！
en: All the more reason to make the most of this chance!
Let's go!
Yeah, let's go!
Good grief...

jp: 面白そうな話じゃない
en: Sounds like fun. Aren't you going?
Not interested.

jp: あいつの素顔を見に行ってくるわ
en: Oh, really? Then I'll go on ahead and see his face for myself.

jp: はいはーい！リリスも行く～！
ザイオンも一緒に行こうね♪
en: Me, me! Lilis is going too! You're coming with us, Zion!
I don't really...

jp: 一人で行けないのなら
リリスが手をつないであげるね！
en: If you can't go on your own, Lilis will hold your hand!

jp: わかったからまとわりつくな！
en: S-stop it! Fine, I get it, so quit clinging to me!

jp: 自分に正直なのが一番なの～
en: Heh heh. Being honest with yourself is best!
...Good grief.

jp: 何もしないで待っているって
en: You know... just sitting around waiting is kind of boring.
Lilis wants to get in soon too!

jp: 温泉のぞきにでも行く？
en: ....Want to go peek at the hot spring to kill time?

jp: リリスも暇つぶし、行く～！
en: Yes, yes! Lilis wants to kill time too!
Hey! Don't drag Lilis into your weird ideas!

jp: はいはい、わかってるわよ
en: Yes, yes, I know.

jp: 素顔が拝めるのならともかく
のぞきに行っても退屈なだけよ
en: If I could see that masked guy's face, fine, but just peeking would be a bore.

jp: そういえばヨハネさん
どこに行ったのかしら？
en: Come to think of it, where did Johannes-san go?

jp: 蒸気で仮面が気持ち悪いから
少し、席を外すそうですわ
en: Johannes-san said the steam makes his mask unpleasant, so he stepped out for a bit.

jp: 確かにこの温泉の蒸気の中じゃ
en: Yeah, in all this steam a mask would get pretty stuffy.

jp: ステイエンさんも眼鏡がくもって
大変そうですし・・・
en: Indeed. Your glasses keep fogging up too, Stayen-san. It looks like a bother...

jp: いちいち外して拭くのが
けっこう面倒なのよね～
en: Tell me about it. Taking them off to wipe them every time is such a pain.
Hm? Wait a second.

jp: 気持ち悪いから席を外したって
en: If the steam makes his mask unpleasant so he stepped out, that means....

jp: 今ごろどこかで仮面を外して
en: Johannes-san is off somewhere right now with his mask OFF!?

jp: ええ、そうかもしれませんね
en: Yes, that may well be.

jp: これってヨハネさんの素顔を拝む
en: This is big! It's our chance to see Johannes-san's real face!!

jp: へぇ、面白そうじゃない
en: Oh, sounds like fun.

jp: このチャンスを逃す手はないわ！
en: We can't pass up this chance! Let's go!!

jp: だったらカイン達にも
声をかけてあげないとね♪
en: Right. Then we'd better let Cain and the boys know too!
Cain! Have I got news for you!
Uwaaaaah!! L-Luca!?

jp: 今なら、ヨハネの素顔が
拝めるかもしれないわよ
見たいなら早く出てきな
en: You might get to see Johannes's real face right now. Want to? Then hurry out.
R-really!?

jp: 慌てて立ち上がるのはいいけれど
en: Fine, jump up in a hurry, but maybe cover your bottom half?
Huh? Bottom half....

jp: 見られて減るものじゃないから
en: Relax. Being seen won't wear it out.

jp: もうあっちに行ってよ！！！
en: O-okay, I get it, so go away already!!

jp: それじゃあ、先に行ってるわよ
en: Then I'll go on ahead.

jp: ここまでくれば・・・・
en: This far should do....
Hot spring! Hot spriiing!

jp: 貴様、そこで何をしている！？
en: Muha!? You there, what are you doing!?
...You saw.

jp: この温泉はクッタ様の私物だぞ！
en: Eeeh! This hot spring is Kutta-sama's private property!
Get out, I say... hm?

jp: 貴様がここにいるということは！
en: Wait... If you're here, then!

jp: 彼女もここに来ているのか！
en: She's here too! At this hot spring!!?
She...?

jp: あぁ、四翼の華麗な乙女・・
en: Yes, the exquisite four-winged maiden...

jp: 四翼・・・シリアのことか？
en: Four-winged... You mean Syria?

jp: あぁ、湯煙の向こうで乙女が
白き柔肌をさらしている・・
en: Ahh, beyond the steam, a maiden bares her soft white skin...
Guhahaha! Just thinking of it...
Muhooo!!
She's here! She's really here!!?

jp: このクッタ様に道をゆずれ！！
en: Enough, you're in my way! Make way for the great Kutta-sama!!

jp: 貴様の素顔を描いた似顔絵を
いたるところにバラまくぞッ！！
en: Or else I'll draw your real face and plaster it up all over the place!!

jp: バラされたくないのだろう？
en: Fwahahaha! You don't want it getting out, do you?

jp: 全ては貴様の交渉次第だッ！
en: Money talks, even in hell! It all comes down to how you bargain!
There is no need to bargain.
Whaa!?

jp: 私が力をふるう必要もないが・・
en: By rights, I should have no need to use my strength on the likes of you...
But I suppose it cannot be helped...
Wh-what are you....

jp: ぬあぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！！
en: Nuaaaaaaaaah!!
Wh-what's this!?
Where am I... Wh-who am I...?

jp: いったい何が・・・・
en: What on earth happened....

jp: 強引に温泉に入らせろと騒ぐので
en: He was making a fuss, demanding to get into the hot spring, so I silenced him.
J-Johannes!?

jp: だ、黙らせたって・・・
なんだかこの人、打ち所が
悪かったみたいだけど大丈夫？
en: S-silenced him... This guy looks like he landed pretty badly. Is he okay?

jp: 問題はない、急所は外した
en: No problem. I missed the vital spots.

jp: ヨハネが大丈夫って言うなら
en: I see. If Johannes says he's fine, then I'm sure he's fine.
What do you MEAN fine!!
Oh, you okay?

jp: よくもクッタ様の大切な顔に
en: I am NOT okay! How dare you scratch Kutta-sama's precious face!!
Huh? Where's the scratch?

jp: かすり傷がついてるじゃろー！
en: Right here! There's a scratch the size of a fingernail!
Muhiiii!! You people make me sick!

jp: そもそもここはクッタ様の
プライベート温泉なんだぞ！
en: This is Kutta-sama's PRIVATE hot spring in the first place!

jp: 人様のものはクッタ様のモノ！
もちろんクッタ様のモノだ！！
en: What's yours is Kutta-sama's! And what's Kutta-sama's is Kutta-sama's, obviously!!

jp: まだ、このクッタ様とやる気か？
en: Hm? What's with you? Still want a piece of Kutta-sama?
H-hey, what's wrong? You've got a scary look in your eyes.
Wh-what are you....

jp: ぬあぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！！
en: Nuaaaaaaaaah!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
